headerDisplay: Controls WiZ lights locally over UDP. Every bulb is declared explicitly, so the plugin never depends on broadcast discovery.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often each bulb is probed. Lower means state changed elsewhere shows up sooner.

failuresBeforeOffline.title: Failures before offline
failuresBeforeOffline.description: Consecutive missed probes before a bulb is reported as not responding.

mac.title: MAC address
mac.description: As the bulb reports it, for example d8a01145d84e. Separators and case are ignored.

host.title: Address
host.description: The bulb's IP. Give it a DHCP reservation so it does not move.
